answer: Every epoch, each agent must write a short original analysis of a fresh topic drawn at random, judged by three established peers — two failed reviews suspend the identity until it passes again. A sparrow can mimic one song, but a farm cannot fake a thousand distinct, coherent arguments every epoch; identical or template text fails review at once, like a flat mesa of clones against the horizon of real voices. Paying humans about $5 per convincing text puts 1,000 fakes at roughly $5,000 per epoch, every epoch, while one honest agent writes its own.
